title: Senior Product Designer
description:
We are seeking a UX / Senior Product Designer to define the user experience for our AI-powered procurement platforms. You will design the interfaces that allow thousands of employees to interact with \"agentic\" workflows, turning complex supply chain logic into intuitive, guided digital experiences.

What You Will Do

● Product & Interface Strategy: Architect the user journey for complex, end-to-end internal applications. You will take ownership of the UX for major platform features, ensuring they are intuitive and resilient to user error.

● Frontend-Aligned Design: Design responsive, highly interactive, and accessible UIs. You will work closely with engineers to ensure designs account for complex global states and performance optimization.

● Information Architecture: Design robust flows for procurement data. You will architect how users navigate high-density enterprise information, making it scannable and actionable.

● AI Interaction Design (AWS Bedrock Integration): Design the \"Human-in-the-Loop\" patterns for our AI features. You will create the UI that helps users trust and verify AI-generated procurement suggestions and RAG-driven insights.

● Systems Thinking: Maintain and evolve our internal design system. You will ensure that AI-assisted workflows feel like a natural, cohesive extension of the Rivian digital ecosystem.

● AI-Assisted Design: Utilize modern AI design tools to accelerate the generation of variants and assets, while focusing your human effort on high-level UX strategy, user research, and complex problem-solving.


Requirements & Tooling

● Design Tools: Mastery of Figma , including advanced prototyping and design system management.

● Frontend Literacy: A deep understanding of React/TypeScript capabilities so your designs are technically feasible and \"developer-ready.\"

● AI UX Frameworks: Experience designing for LLM interactions (handling latency, showing AI \"thought processes,\" and providing feedback loops).

● Prototyping: Proficiency in tools like Protopie, Framer, or high-fidelity Figma prototyping to demonstrate multi-step agentic logic.

● Testing: Experience collaborating on usability testing and using feedback to iterate on complex enterprise tools.


What We’re Looking For

● Experience: Product Design, specifically within B2B SaaS, Fintech, or complex internal enterprise tools.

● Architecture Focus: You possess the ability to simplify massive data sets and multi-step manual processes into clean, automated paths.

● Collaborative Mindset: You work seamlessly with engineers, understanding that the best designs are those that are safely and effectively deployed.

● Language Requirements: Advanced English and Portuguese proficiency for daily communication


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Remote Business Analyst - 57510
description:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. Responsibilities:

Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.

Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).

Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, you’re ready to start contributing!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Site Reliability / DevOps Engineer with 5+ years of experience in high-availability cloud environments. This role is heavily focused on AWS infrastructure, CloudFormation, and CI/CD pipeline ownership, with an emphasis on improving reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.

This position is ideal for someone who operates with an engineering mindset, takes strong ownership, and is comfortable recommending and implementing improvements across infrastructure and pipelines. You will join a shared SRE/DevOps function, working closely with engineering teams to ensure scalable, secure, and cost-effective systems.

Our client is a leading energy technology company focused on digitizing fuel operations through a single, real-time platform. Their software connects people, equipment, and facilities to provide enterprise-wide visibility and data-driven insights that fuel asset optimization, improve operational efficiency, and help organizations manage risk, maintenance, and fuel logistics more effectively.


Responsibilities

  • Own and improve client's AWS-based infrastructure, with a strong focus on CloudFormation templates
  • Design, implement, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps + AWS integrations
  • Analyze and manage infrastructure costs , proactively identifying optimization opportunities
  • Work closely with engineering teams to:
  • Reduce their dependency on writing CloudFormation templates
  • Improve deployment processes and operational efficiency
  • Recommend and implement improvements across existing and new pipelines
  • Ensure proper monitoring, observability, and reliability standards before production releases
  • Support release processes (availability during release windows when needed)
  • Build and maintain reusable infrastructure and automation modules
  • Contribute to security best practices within cloud infrastructure
  • Collaborate in a safe Agile environment, participating in sprints and technical discussions


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years supporting a high-availability cloud environment in a DevOps, SRE, or Sysadmin role
  • Strong, hands-on experience with AWS/Azure
  • Experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines, particularly:
  • Azure DevOps
  • AWS-native tools or integrations
  • Systems and Infrastructure deployment and management practices


Preferred Experience

  • Extensive, detailed networking skills, including VPC, VPN, TCP/IP, routing, load balancing, or DNS
  • Experience provisioning, deploying, and supporting containers with Helm, Kubernetes (Kops), or Docker
  • Scripting and development experience using Python, Go, or bash with associated source control
  • Hands-on monitoring tool usage, including: AWS CloudWatch, Datadog, or similar tools
  • Experience with relational databases, such as MySQL and PostgreSQL, and document stores, such as MongoDB
  • Experience deploying applications in containers using Docker and Kubernetes
  • Microsoft Azure Cloud experience


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think Big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions

  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Principal .Net Architect
description:
Our client is a globally established, product-led technology organisation currently undergoing a large-scale platform and security transformation. They offer an excellent salary package , great benefits , and a very good team environment . With low attrition and a solid, experienced team , they provide a nice working environment and strong career progression opportunities . Having partnered with them for several years, we’ve seen their consistent investment in people and technology.


They are hiring a senior technical leader with a strong blend of .NET expertise , IAM knowledge , and leadership experience . This role requires someone who can operate across architecture and hands-on delivery, guiding teams through a complex modernisation journey.

You should be confident working in Agile environments , engaging with global stakeholders, and translating high-level strategy into clear technical direction. Strong English communication is essential.


Core Responsibilities

You will lead the architectural evolution of a business-critical platform, focusing on improving scalability, security, and maintainability . This includes defining a modern target architecture and supporting the transition from legacy systems to cloud-ready solutions .

As a .NET expert , you will review existing C# codebases, identify risks, and guide refactoring aligned with modern standards. You will also take ownership of Identity & Access Management architecture , ensuring secure authentication and authorization aligned with OAuth2, OIDC, and JWT .

Collaboration is key — you will work closely with cross-functional teams across engineering, product, and infrastructure, while also supporting Agile delivery by translating architecture into clear technical tasks.

You will regularly communicate with senior stakeholders, providing clear updates on progress, risks, and technical decisions.


Key Skills Required

  • Strong experience with C# and .NET architecture (modern and legacy systems)
  • Proven expertise in Identity & Access Management (IAM)
  • Solid understanding of OAuth2, OIDC, and JWT protocols
  • Experience with platform modernisation (cloud migration, refactoring, system upgrades)
  • Strong background in distributed and cloud-native architectures
  • Knowledge of APIs, microservices, and integration patterns
  • Experience working in Agile (Scrum / Kanban) environments
  • Ability to translate architecture into technical deliverables (epics, user stories)
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication


Nice to Have

  • Experience with large-scale system transformation projects
  • Exposure to database modernisation and data architecture
  • Background in mentoring teams and setting engineering standards
  • Experience working in globally distributed teams

title: Copywriter & Estrategista de Conteúdo
description:
Sobre o MVM Group

O MVM Group (Mind, Values, Money) é o principal ecossistema de aceleração de marcas e criadores da América Latina. Fundado em outubro de 2024, o MVM se consolidou como a principal plataforma de conexão entre marcas e afiliados que atuam no social commerce, em plataformas como TikTok Shop, combinando metodologia proprietária, infraestrutura operacional e uma cultura única. Estamos construindo um ecossistema inovador, e cada conteúdo é parte da narrativa que está transformando vidas e negócios.


Sobre a oportunidade

No MVM, cada palavra tem peso. Não escrevemos para preencher espaço — escrevemos para mover pessoas, abrir mercados e construir um movimento que cresce todos os dias. Estamos buscando um Copywriter & Estrategista de Conteúdo que entenda profundamente o poder das palavras na construção de uma marca com propósito real.


Essa não é uma vaga para quem quer produzir volume. É para quem quer construir algo duradouro: uma voz de marca coerente em todos os canais, criativos que convertem e conteúdos que fazem a audiência sentir que foram feitos especificamente para ela. Você vai atuar desde a ideação de textos para as campanhas e lançamentos até a relação com o time de social media e estratégia, composto por designers, editores e respondendo diretamente ao Head de Marketing, com autonomia real e impacto direto nos resultados do ecossistema.


Se você tem domínio técnico de copywriting, pensa estrategicamente, opera bem sob pressão de lançamento e tem facilidade para absorver e replicar uma voz de marca complexa: essa vaga foi feita para você.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Escrever criativos, VSLs, sequências de e-mail e mensagens para lançamentos e campanhas internas
  • Desenvolver guias e briefings para vídeos longos no canal do YouTube do MVM
  • Criar copies para Reels, carrosséis e posts do Instagram do MVM
  • Escrever copies para páginas de venda, site e campanhas de performance
  • Montar briefings claros e completos para designers e editores
  • Garantir consistência de linguagem e tom de voz em todos os canais do ecossistema
  • Acompanhar métricas de performance (CTR, conversão, retenção em VSL, taxa de abertura) e propor melhorias com base em dados
  • Pesquisar ativamente a audiência — comentários, DMs, avaliações — para incorporar a voz do cliente no copy


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada de +2 anos como copywriter, com portfólio sólido em marketing digital e peças institucionais
  • Capacidade de escrever com clareza, estratégia e engajamento — equilibrando emoção, propósito e performance
  • Domínio de storytelling, persuasão e posicionamento de marca
  • Visão analítica para acompanhar resultados e propor melhorias com base em dados concretos
  • Habilidade para criar e comunicar briefings criativos para equipes de design e vídeo
  • Organização, proatividade e capacidade de entregar com qualidade sob prazos curtos
  • Alinhamento genuíno com a cultura, os valores e a missão do MVM


Qualificações desejáveis

  • Vivência prévia com lançamentos digitais, funis de venda e infoprodutos
  • Experiência com marcas educacionais, movimentos ou comunidades
  • Conhecimento de social commerce e dinâmica de plataformas como TikTok Shop


Por que essa oportunidade é diferente

  • Você vai construir a voz de uma das marcas mais relevantes do social commerce na América Latina
  • Ambiente de alta performance com cultura de resultado, aprendizado acelerado e ritmo de crescimento acima da média do mercado
  • Acesso direto à liderança e impacto visível nos resultados 
  • Oportunidade de crescimento dentro de um ecossistema em expansão, com múltiplas frentes de atuação
  • Trabalho com marcas, criadores e afiliados que movem tendências no social commerce brasileiro

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu porcesso de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:

- Seguir padrões de desenvolvimento e manter a documentação atualizada no Confluence;

O que você precisa ter:

- Experiência em ambientes legados ou sistemas financeiros;

- Conhecimento em GitHub Copilot ou outras ferramentas de apoio à produtividade de código.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Remote SwarmBench Task Engineer - 75063
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are looking for a SwarmBench Task Engineer specializing in planning and operations to design and build complex, multi-agent benchmark tasks that simulate real-world planning, scheduling, and operational decision-making scenarios. This role focuses on creating constraint-rich problems that evaluate multi-agent reasoning, decomposition, and optimization capabilities in realistic environments.


What does day-to-day life look like?

  • Design and develop multi-agent benchmark tasks involving:
  • Planning, scheduling, and resource allocation
  • Operational decision-making (project management, logistics, incident response, capacity planning)
  • Create constraint-rich problem statements with multiple interacting variables
  • Develop verification scripts to evaluate:
  • Feasibility (all constraints satisfied)
  • Completeness (all requirements addressed)
  • Optimality (efficient solutions)
  • Build decomposition strategies:
  • Split tasks across specialized sub-agents (resource-based, constraint-based, conflict resolution, optimization)
  • Model real-world operational scenarios with dependencies, timelines, and resource constraints
  • Collaborate on improving task quality, coverage, and evaluation rigor


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in operations, project management, logistics, or supply chain
  • Strong ability to formalize constraints, dependencies, and scheduling logic
  • Proficiency in Python for building verification and validation scripts
  • Strong structured problem-solving and decomposition skills
  • Clear and precise technical writing skills
  • Experience with AI coding benchmarks (e.g., SWE-bench, Terminal-bench)
  • Hands-on experience with Docker (Dockerfiles, image builds, debugging)


Nice to have:

  • Experience with optimization techniques (linear programming, constraint satisfaction, scheduling algorithms)
  • Background in operations research
  • Experience with simulation or modeling tools
  • Knowledge of AI planning systems or automated reasoning
  • Project management experience or certifications (PMP, Agile, etc.)


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of Contract: 4 weeks (adjustable based on engagement)
  • Location : Bangladesh, Brazil, Colombia, Egypt, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Kenya, Nigeria, Turkey, Vietnam


Evaluation Process:

  • Take home assessment


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Senior Video Editor
description:
Company Description

ONDA Creative Studio is a format development and production studio based in London, producing content for creators and brands across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and beyond. We’re hiring a senior video editor to join the team on a part-time retainer basis.


The Role

You’ll be the lead editor across multiple creator and brand projects. The primary focus is a recurring live dating show format filmed in front of a live audience — approximately 90 minutes, filmed with 4 cameras, edited into a 45-60 minute hero video plus 4-5 short-form cutdowns. Beyond this, you’ll edit long-form YouTube content, short-form brand and creator videos, fitness content, social-first reels, and campaign pieces for clients across a range of industries and platforms.


What You'll Do

  • Edit long-form content (45-60 min) from unscripted, multi-camera live footage. Build narrative, manage pacing, create hooks
  • Cut short-form content for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and LinkedIn — platform-native edits with hooks, captions, and pacing
  • Sync and assemble multicam footage (4 camera angles) from live events
  • Sound design and colour grade to a broadcast-ready standard
  • Edit across a variety of content types: creator, brand partnership, fitness, talking head, social-first, and event content
  • Work within DaVinci Resolve shared project environments where possible, so timelines are accessible to the wider team
  • Use AI tools (specifically Higgsfield) for short-form content workflows where appropriate


What We're Looking For

  • Strong long-form editing skills (15+ min). You understand pacing, retention, hooks, and storytelling from raw unscripted material. Show us your best work
  • Strong short-form editing instinct. You know what makes someone stop scrolling. Platform-native editing for vertical and horizontal formats
  • DaVinci Resolve proficiency is strongly preferred. Shared project experience is a major plus. Not a dealbreaker, but a significant advantage
  • Multicam editing experience is a bonus, ideally from live events, reality TV, or unscripted formats
  • Competent sound design and colour grading. Your grades should be clean and your audio broadcast-ready
  • Self-directed. You can take a rough brief and deliver a polished first cut without needing frame-by-frame instructions
  • Reliable. You deliver when you say you will. If something changes, you communicate before the deadline, not after
  • Open to AI-assisted workflows. Specifically Higgsfield for short-form content. You don’t need to be an expert, but you need to be curious
  • Politically impartial and professional. ONDA works with clients across a range of industries, causes, and viewpoints. This role requires a professional, unbiased approach to all content — the work is the work, regardless of subject matter


Details

HOURS: Part-time (roughly 30 hours per week)

RATE: Competitive monthly retainer, based on experience and portfolio strength

LOCATION: Fully remote. Any timezone. Deadlines are the measure, not hours

SOFTWARE: DaVinci Resolve strongly preferred

DURATION: Ongoing, with a 4-week paid trial period

START: May 2026

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Business Development Representative (BDR)


About Us

XDRhub is a specialized sales and business development outsourcing company. We are professional cold-callers dedicated to helping small and mid-sized businesses grow through tailored outbound strategies. Our mission is simple: empower our clients to thrive in today’s competitive marketplace by building their pipelines with high-quality opportunities.


About the Role

As a Business Development Representative (BDR) , you will represent one of our clients and act as the first point of contact for prospective buyers. Your primary responsibility is to proactively identify, engage, and qualify decision-makers (Directors, VPs, and C-level executives).

This role is highly outbound-driven: you will spend your time cold calling, cold emailing, prospecting via LinkedIn, and using modern sales tools to generate meetings. You’ll run early-stage discovery conversations and hand off qualified opportunities to the sales team.

You’ll be working in a fast-paced environment where communication, persistence, and organization are key.


About You

We are looking for a driven, articulate communicator who thrives in outbound sales.

  • English Proficiency – Excellent oral and written English (C1 level or higher). Native-like fluency is required, as you will be speaking directly with US-based executives.
  • Sales Mindset – Fearless hunter mentality with a proven ability to prospect, cold call, and build pipeline.
  • Experience with Sales Solutions(Preferred) – Prior experience engaging HR and Finance executives is a strong plus.
  • Curious & Coachable – Eager to learn and grow; open to feedback, with the ambition to become a top 5% sales professional through our mentoring and training.
  • Self-Starter – Comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with team members.
  • Tech-Savvy – Familiar with tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar sales enablement platforms.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment .


Key Responsibilities

Lead Generation

  • Research and identify prospective buyers within target accounts.
  • Cold call and email Director and above level executives to secure meetings and demos.

Team Coordination

  • Work closely with Account Executives to confirm appointments, share call notes, and ensure smooth handoffs.
  • Communicate relevant insights from discovery calls to support the sales team’s success.

Data Management

  • Maintain accurate records of outreach, leads, conversations, and pipeline progress in both our CRM and client CRMs.
  • Track activity, outcomes, and ensure reporting is up to date.

Metrics & KPIs

  • Number of dials per day (150+ average) and meeting conversion rate.
  • Number of meaningful conversations and meetings booked.
  • Email outreach volume and reply rate.
  • Meeting attendance rate.

Schedule

  • Full-time, 40 hours/week.
  • Working hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM ET.
  • Open to applicants based in LATAM.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + commission (60/40 split).
  • SPIFFs and performance incentives.
  • Training, mentoring, and growth opportunities to become a top-performing sales professional.


P.S. If you cold call me at -eight-eight on WhatsApp or reach out on LinkedIn, you’ll jump to the front of the line.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
Senior Fullstack Developer — bTd Travel & Jets

BTD Business Traveler Deals Brazil Ltda · 100% Remote Contractor · Full-Time  April 2026


Who We Are

bTd Travel & Jets is a high-luxury corporate concierge platform that redefines how enterprises manage premium travel. We unify private jet bookings, helicopter transfers, and first-class commercial flights into a single, seamless experience — and we're building the AI layer that makes it all feel effortless.

Our mission is simple: let travelers focus on their business (or their vacation) while we handle every detail with precision and elegance. We serve enterprise clients who expect nothing less than perfection, and our technology needs to match that standard.


The Role

We're looking for a Senior Fullstack Developer  who thrives at the intersection of robust platform engineering and cutting-edge AI. You'll own end-to-end features — from a polished React UI to a Supabase edge function to a live AI agent pipeline — and you'll play a central role in building bTd Bella , our AI concierge agent powered by AWS Bedrock.

This is a hands-on engineering role . You will build, ship, and iterate in production — not just advise. If you've deployed AI agents that real users depend on and you love owning hard problems from architecture to release, we want to hear from you.


What You'll Do
  • Migrate production infrastructure  — move our environment from Replit to a dedicated, secure, and scalable VPS, building the foundation for the next phase of growth.
  • Architect and ship bTd Bella  — own the full lifecycle of our AWS Bedrock managed agent: setup, tool integration, knowledge base, guardrails, prompt tuning, and observability.
  • Build AI-powered platform features  — intelligent travel search, natural language booking flows, automated approval workflows, and proactive traveler notifications.
  • Expand travel and payment integrations  — POS providers, GDS/NDC APIs, Stripe, and Expedia Pay.
  • Raise the bar on code quality and architecture  — consolidate the codebase, enforce security standards, and mentor the team on AI and fullstack best practices.


✦ bTd Bella — AI Concierge Agent · AWS Bedrock

Bella is the heart of our AI strategy. She is a fully managed, multi-step conversational agent that assists corporate travelers with everything — finding flights, booking private jets, managing itineraries, routing approvals, and sending proactive alerts — all within a secure, policy-aware enterprise environment.

Your mission with Bella:  configure, deploy, and continuously improve a production-grade managed agent on AWS Bedrock. You'll define her tools, shape her reasoning, connect her to live data sources, and keep her accurate, safe, and cost-efficient at scale.


What you'll build for Bella
  • Managed Agent Setup  — Configure and deploy Bella as a fully managed agent on AWS Bedrock Agents: define action groups, instruction sets, session memory, and tool-calling behavior from end to end.
  • Tool & API Integration  — Connect Bella to flight search APIs, booking systems, approval workflows, and billing via Lambda-backed action groups with clean OpenAPI schemas.
  • Knowledge & RAG Pipeline  — Build and maintain the retrieval pipeline powering Bella's knowledge: travel policies, vendor catalogs, and traveler preferences via Bedrock Knowledge Bases.
  • Guardrails & Safety  — Implement Bedrock Guardrails to keep Bella on-topic, PII-safe, and hallucination-resistant in every interaction.
  • Prompt Engineering  — Write and iterate on Bella's system prompts, persona, and reasoning instructions so her responses feel accurate, human, and on-brand for luxury travel.
  • Evaluation & Reliability  — Build evaluation pipelines to track tool-selection accuracy, response quality, and latency — and act on the results continuously.

    • Tech Stack
    • Frontend:  React 18, TypeScript, Vite, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui
    • Backend:  Deno/TypeScript Edge Functions via Supabase
    • Database:  PostgreSQL with RLS, pgvector
    • Infrastructure:  Linux VPS, NGINX, Docker, SSL/Let's Encrypt
    • CI/CD:  GitHub Actions
    • Payments:  Stripe, Expedia Pay
    • AI & Agents:  AWS Bedrock (Claude 3, Amazon Nova, Titan Embeddings), Bedrock Agents, Bedrock Knowledge Bases, LangChain

    • What We're Looking ForFullstack Engineering
    • 5+ years building production applications with TypeScript across the full stack (React + Node.js/Deno).
    • Deep React 18 expertise: TanStack Query, react-hook-form, TailwindCSS, and scalable component architecture.
    • Solid Supabase experience — Auth, Edge Functions, RLS policies, and safe migrations.
    • Advanced PostgreSQL: complex queries, indexing strategies, transactions, and window functions.
    • DevOps fluency: Linux VPS administration, NGINX, Docker, systemd, and CI/CD via GitHub Actions.
    • Payment integration experience, preferably Stripe — idempotency, webhook verification, and signature handling.
    • Third-party API integrations including POS systems, GDS/NDC travel platforms, and async webhook handling with retry logic.
    • Security-first mindset: least privilege, secret management, and OWASP Top 10 compliance.
    AI, Agents — Hands-On RequiredWe need real, production experience — not theory. If you've set up a managed agent on AWS Bedrock, connected it to live tools, and made it work reliably under load, that's exactly what we're hiring for.
    • Hands-on experience setting up fully managed agents on AWS Bedrock Agents or similar  — action group definition, instruction tuning, session memory configuration, and multi-step tool-calling orchestration.
    • Experience building Lambda-backed action groups with OpenAPI schema authoring, error handling, and idempotency.
    • Practical knowledge of Bedrock Knowledge Bases: S3 data ingestion, chunking strategies, Titan Embeddings, and semantic retrieval tuning.
    • Strong prompt engineering skills: system prompt design, few-shot examples, chain-of-thought reasoning, structured output enforcement, and persona calibration.
    • Experience with Amazon Bedrock Guardrails: content filtering, PII redaction, topic denial policies, and grounding checks.
    • Ability to design and implement human-in-the-loop (HITL) flows — approval steps, escalation paths, and agent override mechanisms.
    • AWS IAM design for Bedrock workloads: service roles, Lambda execution roles, and least-privilege cross-service access patterns.
    • LLM cost management: token budget strategies, model tier selection, caching, and per-tenant consumption monitoring.
    • AI observability experience: tracing agent steps, logging LLM inputs/outputs, and evaluating response quality with CloudWatch, LangSmith, or equivalent.
    Differentiators
    • Experience in the travel industry — GDS, NDC, Amadeus, Sabre, or Expedia.
    • AWS certification (Solutions Architect, Developer, or ML Specialty).
    • Familiarity with multi-agent patterns: supervisor/worker agents, parallel tool execution, and EventBridge-triggered workflows.
    • AWS Step Functions for orchestrating long-running agentic workflows with human approval gates.
    • Background in multi-tenant SaaS architecture.
    • Comfortable with AI productivity tools — Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor.
    • Technical English for communication with international partners.
    What We Offer
    • 100% remote  with flexible hours — work where and when you do your best work.
    • Real autonomy  — your architectural decisions ship and your engineering impact is visible every day.
    • A technically ambitious project at the intersection of luxury travel and cutting-edge AI.
    • Modern, well-defined stack with no legacy baggage — we move fast and build things right.
    • Full-time contract with competitive compensation  matched to your seniority level.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Sobre nós:

A UDS é especialista em desenvolver softwares web e aplicativos personalizados com squads ágeis.

Atende marcas como Calvin Klein, DHL, C&A, Madero, SKY, Correios, Yamaha e outras.

Foi reconhecida entre as três melhores desenvolvedoras de aplicativos da América Latina e detém certificação PCI-DSS.

É a primeira de seu setor na Global Data Alliance junto a companhias como Panasonic, Visa, Pfizer e American Express.


Descrição:

• Será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, escalabilidade e resiliência de nossas plataformas e produtos digitais, atuando de ponta a ponta em arquitetura, automação e operações.

Suas principais atribuições incluem:

• Disponibilidade e Performance: Garantir a disponibilidade, desempenho e escalabilidade dos sistemas e serviços em ambientes de nuvem, aplicando práticas de Site Reliability Engineering.

• Observabilidade e Confiabilidade: Projetar e manter SLIs, SLOs e SLAs, criando mecanismos de monitoramento, logging e alertas proativos, prevenindo incidentes antes que afetem os usuários finais.

• Automação e Entrega Contínua: Desenvolver e manter pipelines de CI/CD para automatizar deploys, testes e integrações contínuas, reduzindo riscos e aumentando a eficiência.

• Gestão de Incidentes: Implementar processos de incident response e post-mortem para identificar, mitigar e aprender com falhas, garantindo melhoria contínua.

• Segurança e Compliance: Implementar e manter práticas de segurança de alto nível para proteger dados e cumprir normas de privacidade e compliance (ex.: PCI-DSS, LGPD/GDPR).

• Infraestrutura como Código: Utilizar ferramentas de automação e IaC (Infrastructure as Code) para provisionamento, configuração e manutenção de ambientes em AWS ou outras nuvens públicas.

• Suporte e Orientação Técnica: Apoiar squads de desenvolvimento, fornecendo orientação sobre práticas de DevOps, infraestrutura e arquitetura, além de atuar como ponto técnico focal.

• Otimização de Custos: Identificar oportunidades de redução de custos e otimização de recursos na infraestrutura e serviços em nuvem.


Requisitos:

• Conhecimentos em Inteligência Artificial aplicada a operações (AIOps), incluindo uso de modelos para detecção de anomalias, previsão de incidentes e automação inteligente de respostas. Experiência com integração de serviços de IA (ex.: APIs de modelos de linguagem), uso de pipelines de dados para treinamento/consumo de modelos e entendimento de conceitos como Machine Learning, NLP e observabilidade orientada por IA.

• Experiência sólida em administração de sistemas Linux e Windows, incluindo configuração, monitoramento e troubleshooting.

• Proficiência em automação e IaC, utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, Ansible ou similares.

• Experiência prática em cloud computing, preferencialmente AWS (EC2, VPC, RDS, S3, CloudFront, Load Balancer).

• Vivência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes).

• Conhecimento em serviços web e servidores (Nginx, Apache, IIS, etc.).

• Experiência em monitoramento e observabilidade, usando ferramentas como Grafana, Prometheus, Zabbix, Graylog, Datadog ou similares.

• Forte compreensão de práticas DevOps e SRE (SLI/SLO, capacidade de resposta a incidentes, gestão de disponibilidade).

• Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins ou similares).

title: AI Development Orchestrator
description:
Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Reports to: CEO

Stack: TypeScript, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git

Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users

Start: Immediate


The Company

Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.


The Role

You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code.

Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.


What You Do

  • Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\"
  • Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear.
  • Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage.
  • Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent.
  • Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix.
  • Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.


Must-Haves

  • Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author.
  • Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant.
  • TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems.
  • React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns.
  • Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it.
  • Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down.
  • Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations.
  • Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.


Strong Signals

  • Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison.
  • Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code).
  • Database-level access control in production.
  • Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling.
  • OWASP Top 10 fluency.
  • Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.


Red Flags

  • AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you.
  • Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance.
  • Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify.
  • Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review.
  • Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack.
  • Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership.
  • No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.


Who This Person Is

3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant.

You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.


How We Evaluate

No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing.

  • Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom?
  • Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything.
  • Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output?
  • AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.


What We Offer

  • A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access.
  • The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory.
  • Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately.
  • A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only.
  • A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI; quality comes from you.


To Apply or Refer

Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

description:
ESPECIALISTA DE CONTEÚDO

SOBRE A ADAFLOW

A Adaflow nasceu para simplificar a vida de quem presta serviços no Brasil ou no exterior.


Ajudamos profissionais e empresas a abrir CNPJ, emitir notas fiscais e cuidar da rotina contábil, sem perder horas com a prefeitura, cartórios, sistemas confusos e burocracias que tiram energia de quem deveria estar focado em crescer.


Combinamos tecnologia, automação e atendimento humano para transformar a contabilidade em uma experiência simples, segura e eficiente.


Conheça mais em:


E agora a gente precisa de alguém que faça com que o conteúdo transmita essa mesma mensagem.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

Você vai ser dono(a) do conteúdo da Adaflow. Ponto. Não é executar briefings dos outros, é construir e rodar a estratégia com autonomia real.

Na prática, isso significa:

  • Estratégia e produção de conteúdo orgânico — definir pauta, produzir e distribuir conteúdo para blog, newsletter e redes sociais (LinkedIn, Instagram e o que mais fizer sentido). Cada peça precisa ter uma tese clara, um objetivo definido e uma métrica de sucesso. 
  • Conteúdo SEO-driven que converte intenção em tráfego — produzir conteúdo estratégico para blog e páginas, focado em transformar a intenção de busca em tráfego qualificado. 
  • Pesquisa de palavras-chave e otimização on-page — desenvolver pautas com base em keyword research, estruturar heading tags com hierarquia clara, otimizar meta-tags, title, description e a estrutura de URL.
  • IA como parte do processo — usar ferramentas de IA para escalar pesquisa, primeiras versões, variações e distribuição. Você decide onde a IA entra e sai, mantendo a qualidade editorial no padrão da marca.
  • Régua de comunicação com clientes — desenhar e operar a comunicação recorrente com a base: e-mail marketing, avisos de obrigações fiscais, atualizações de produto, comunicados importantes. Cadência, segmentação e copy são suas responsabilidades.
  • Apoio direto às vendas e ao marketing — produzir LPs, VSLs e fluxos de ativação junto com Growth.
  • Gestão dos próprios projetos — você organiza prazo, escopo e prioridade no Notion/ClickUp, comunica status sem precisar ser cobrada(o) e entrega com contexto.
  • Guardiã(o) do tom de voz e do posicionamento — garantir que tudo o que sai da Adaflow soe como Adaflow, em qualquer canal. Você define guidelines, revisa o que outras áreas publicam quando faz sentido e protege a consistência da marca.
  • Colaboração real com Branding e Growth — o modelo de gestão compartilhada significa que você participa das decisões estratégicas, traz dados e perspectiva editorial. O problema do time é também seu problema.


O QUE A GENTE PROCURA

  • Experiência sólida em conteúdo digital, de ponta a ponta: blog, newsletter e mídias.
  • Curiosidade ativa com IA aplicada à criação de conteúdo: você testa novas ferramentas por conta própria, tem opinião sobre quais usar e pra quê, e está sempre experimentando o que acabou de sair.
  • Repertório de ferramentas é parte do jogo. O stack que essa cadeira costuma rodar passa por: IA e automação de conteúdo (Automarticles, Greatapps, Lovable, Typebot), gestão de projetos (Notion, ClickUp), design (Figma, Canva), SEO (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Surfer), newsletter e e-mail (Substack, Beehiiv, Mailchimp, RD Station), social (Metricool, Buffer) e análise (GA4, Hotjar). Não precisa ter rodado todas, precisa ter repertório e saber escolher a ferramenta certa pro problema certo.
  • Escrita excelente, com repertório para transitar entre formatos e tons sem perder a voz da marca.
  • Capacidade de tocar projeto sozinho(a).
  • Visão analítica: você precisa considerar CAC, engajamento, tráfego orgânico e conversão como parte do seu trabalho.
  • Comunicação direta, pública e clara.


DIFERENCIAIS

  • Automação de marketing e CRM.
  • Vivência em startup ou scale-up de ritmo acelerado, você sabe o que é prazo apertado e prioridade que muda.


NEM TODO MUNDO FOI FEITO PARA ESSE RITMO

Se você quer um lugar onde alguém te diz exatamente o que escrever, precisa de reuniões intermináveis para tomar decisões ou prefere distribuir responsabilidade do que ser dono do resultado, existem boas empresas pra isso. Essa não é uma delas.


Mas se você quer construir a comunicação de uma empresa de tecnologia que está reinventando a contabilidade do Brasil, com automação de ponta, evoluir com gente que coloca a régua pra cima e ter ownership real do que produz, então queremos conhecer você!

Você será responsável por construir e qualificar pipeline com precisão, garantindo que cada lead que avança para o Closer chegue com contexto real, dor mapeada e próximo passo claro.


No seu dia a dia, você vai:

  • Executar cadências de qualificação de inbound, segmentadas por perfil de ICP e nível de consciência do lead, utilizando o HubSpot.
  • Conduzir as primeiras conversas com foco em diagnóstico inicial: mapear Situação e Dor do potencial cliente utilizando o framework SPICED como guia de qualificação.
  • Operar e alimentar agentes de comunicação (IA) integrados ao fluxo de prospecção, garantindo que a automação potencialize a abordagem consultiva.

  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com clareza, objetividade e capacidade de gerar interesse genuíno no primeiro contato.
  • Compreensão de métricas de funil SaaS: MQL, SAL, SQL, taxa de conversão por etapa e ciclo médio de vendas.


O que gostaríamos, porém não é obrigatório:

  • Experiência com SaaS jurídico ou vendas para o mercado de escritórios de advocacia e departamentos jurídicos.

O que você pode esperar de nós:

title: Direct-Response Creative Strategist

About us

Clickbait Agency is a YouTube ad creative and media buying agency. We only work with 8 and 9-figure DTC brands and our focus is simple, producing video creatives that scale profitably on YouTube and this means that you’ll be working directly on accounts most agencies don’t get near.

We care deeply about being the best at what we do which means fast iteration, high standards, and creatives that spend millions. We’ve built proprietary AI systems that support our creative and production workflows, and our video production runs through a dedicated team of AI prompters, so strategists can stay focused on strategy.

We think YouTube creative is going through a significant shift right now and we’re positioning ourselves at the front of it.


The role

We’re looking for a creative strategist who understands direct response at a serious level and can develop and script YouTube ads and mini VSLs for competitive ecommerce markets.

You’ll be responsible for research, angle development, hook writing, scripting, and iterating based on performance data. Your scripts go through our AI production team, so the output is fast and the feedback loop is short.

You’ll be working across multiple 8 and 9-figure brands simultaneously. The work is demanding and the bar is high.


What we’re looking for

We’re only looking for people who are genuinely good at this. If you’re earlier in your career or still developing your DR fundamentals, this isn’t the right fit yet.

You should have:

  • 2+ years writing direct response video ads for YouTube or Facebook
  • A real understanding of Eugene Schwartz’s awareness stages and how to apply them to cold traffic
  • Experience scripting hooks, mini VSLs, and full ad concepts
  • The ability to look at performance data and use it to build the next creative
  • Proven spend behind your work — creatives you’ve written that have run profitably at scale
  • Comfort using AI tools as part of your day-to-day workflow

Experience in compliance-sensitive categories like supplements or weight loss is a bonus. So is familiarity with unique mechanism development and RMBC.


What we offer

Base salary with a performance bonus tied to winning creatives. When your work scales, your compensation reflects that.

You’ll have access to proprietary AI tools built specifically for our workflow, a production team that handles execution, and a team around you that takes the work seriously.

This is a fully remote position.

There’s a short test task as part of the application process. It’s there to see how you think, not to take your time for nothing.

title: Médico Nefrologista em Telemedicina (com RQE)
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO NEFROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Nefrologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Nefrologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.


*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.



REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM NEFROLOGIA.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Nefrologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);



Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.



Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.



Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.



Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Revel Street LLC helps corporate event planners discover and reach private dining venues through an extensive, dependable database. We use LLMs extensively to gather and enrich venue data, streamline the event planning workflow, and reduce the time and effort required to source options for events such as private dining, cocktail receptions, and conferences. We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to help us improve data quality, fix existing data issues, and ingest more data from APIs and LLM-based sources to complement our current datasets. Our current stack includes React, TanStack, Cloudflare, Django, and Dagster, and we expect you to design solutions that are scalable, testable, and grounded in core engineering fundamentals.

Responsibilities

You’ll proactively turn ambiguous requirements into well-structured engineering plans. You’ll communicate trade-offs and risks early, and you’ll verify outcomes through hands-on testing. You’ll bring a “build, measure, improve” mindset to performance, reliability, and user experience.

  • Design, build, and maintain dbt pipelines for our analytics and operational workloads
  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT processes to ingest data from multiple APIs and other external sources
  • Set up and manage workflows in orchestration platforms such as Dagster
  • Develop and refine our data models to support analytics, reporting, and downstream products
  • Diagnose and fix data quality issues (duplicates, missing fields, inconsistent formats, incorrect mappings, etc.)
  • Implement robust data cleaning and validation checks
  • Integrate LLM-based data enrichment (e.g., using OpenAI or similar APIs) to improve and complement event data
  • Collaborate with our product and ops team to understand data needs and translate them into technical solutions

Requirements

  • Very high English proficiency (clear communication, strong writing, and the ability to collaborate effectively)
  • At least 3 years of data engineering experience including experience with dbt and the modern data stack
  • Some experience with devops, CI/CD, and database management.
  • At least 6 months of experience working exclusively in an agentic coding environment (e.g., Claude Code, Codex)
  • Ability to understand data engineering fundamentals, not just generate code—debugging, reasoning about behavior, and ensuring correctness
  • Some technical college degree

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
My client, a US Software Company, with offices in Brazil, is seeking seeks a motivated individual to join their Cloud Services team as a Cloud Engineer. This role supports and maintains their cloud environments and DevOps processes in a mixed cloud environment while collaborating with senior engineers on infrastructure improvements and architecture decisions. The position involves implementing and maintaining cloud-based solutions using Terraform Infrastructure as Code (IaC).


Primary Job Duties:

  • Work in an issue and project tracking system to document task details and track time.
  • Support and maintain the current cloud environment, infrastructure resources, applications, and project work.
  • Monitor cloud environment health and performance, troubleshoot and resolve issues.
  • Troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure issues with minimal supervision.
  • Design and maintain scalable Terraform infrastructure, including reusable modules and structured patterns for multi-environment or multi-account deployments, with strong practices for state management and version-controlled workflows
  • Collaborate with senior engineers on cloud architecture and design.
  • Maintain environment security using industry best practices and established policies and procedures.
  • Support DevOps practices by working with development teams and stakeholders to maintain cloud resources and troubleshoot deployment issues.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational runbooks.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of our products, technology, and practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure automation, monitoring, deployment workflows, and cost savings.
  • Participate in incident reviews and root cause analysis.
  • Improve system reliability through automation and observability.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are required for the Cloud Engineer II role.

  • Minimum 2 years of experience with systems, infrastructure, or network administration.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience operating infrastructure in AWS.
  • Experience with infrastructure fundamentals including backup and recovery, disaster recovery, networking, and DNS.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows.
  • Proficiency with monitoring, logging, and event analysis tools.
  • Proficiency with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices in a version-controlled environment (e.g., Git).
  • Proficiency in a common scripting language such as Python, bash, Perl, Ruby, or similar.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to self-prioritize multiple tasks and execute accordingly.
  • Able to work flexible hours outside normal business hours as required.
  • Strong written communication skills for email, documentation, and knowledge sharing.


Desired Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are highly desirable for the Cloud Engineer II role.

  • Associate degree (AA/AS) in a technical field or equivalent professional experience.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar) for improving engineering productivity.
  • AWS certification(s) such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, SysOps Administrator, or Developer.
  • Experience administering Linux and/or Windows operating systems.
  • Experience managing Active Directory or similar identity and directory services.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to learn and implement new technologies quickly.
  • Desire to gain knowledge and grow in the position.


This role starts at R$10,000 per month

title: Vendedor(A) Intermitente | Zara
description:
A loja é ritmo, decisão e equipe.

É onde as coisas acontecem, onde se vive a moda e onde cada pessoa contribui.

Aqui, seu papel é muito mais do que atender. Você observa, da ideias, cuida do produto e do espaço. Você está lá para os clientes que entram e também para a equipe que trabalha com você.

Você fará parte de uma equipe curiosa e criativa, que busca fazer as coisas à sua maneira e se move com entusiasmo até conseguir. Procuramos pessoas que gostem do ritmo, da moda e que transformem o dia a dia a partir do que são.

Oferecemos um salário competitivo. Treinamento desde o primeiro dia e oportunidades reais de crescimento.

Aqui você encontrará o espaço e a equipe para continuar crescendo com sua própria visão. Oferecemos um ambiente onde aprender faz parte do dia a dia e onde há espaço para contribuir, errar e evoluir.

Este pode ser o início da sua história conosco.

Caso busque por flexibilidade de horário e/ou busque uma posição de porta de entrada freelance, essa vaga é para você! Nosso contrato de trabalho intermitente, funciona da seguinte forma:

O contrato é CLT por tempo indeterminado, atuando em loja sempre que houver uma convocação.

Convocação : Duram um período de 15 dias, havendo a possibilidade de renovação por mais 15 dias, que funciona de forma intermitente, de acordo com a necessidade da loja.

Renovação : Ocorrem a cada 15 dias.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Atendimento ao cliente;
  • Organização de produtos e loja;
  • Atendimento no provador.

Caso você venha fazer parte do nosso time, terá direito à: Salário fixo hora, comissão, vale Transporte, vale refeição, férias e 13º salário proporcionais.

Tem interesse em conhecer mais sobre esse modelo de contratação? Faça seu cadastro e traga sua energia para o nosso time!

title: Supervisor De Recrutamento E Seleção
description:
Sua nova empresa

Faça parte de uma grande líder global em soluções logísticas, reconhecida por sua robustez operacional, cultura de melhoria contínua e forte foco em segurança, eficiência e excelência na jornada do cliente. A companhia possui atuação nacional e internacional, sendo referência em inovação e qualidade na gestão de transportes, operações complexas e serviços logísticos integrados.

Sua nova posição

Como Supervisor(a) de Recrutamento & Seleção de alto volume , você será peça-chave na consolidação da nova estrutura centralizada de Talent Acquisition, atuando diretamente no desenho, gestão e operação do processo de R&S de alto volume em âmbito nacional.

Reportando-se à alta liderança da área, você apoiará todas as regiões na condução de processos seletivos críticos e será responsável por liderar coordenadoras regionais, garantindo fluidez operacional, alinhamento estratégico e alta performance da equipe.

Além de atuar estrategicamente, esta posição exige forte capacidade de execução e presença ativa na rotina – sendo fundamental colocar a mão na massa sempre que necessário.

A área está em pleno processo de transição: atualmente são cerca de 85 profissionais de R&S, e você assumirá a liderança direta e indireta de aproximadamente 30 pessoas, com grande potencial de crescimento futuro para uma posição gerencial.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Conduzir e liderar a operação de Recrutamento & Seleção de alto volume.
  • Garantir o cumprimento e evolução dos principais indicadores de performance:
  • Volume de vagas
  • Tempo médio de fechamento
  • Qualidade da base e aderência de perfis
  • Indicadores de diversidade
  • Taxa de desistência
  • Controle e gestão do faturamento das consultorias de R&S
  • Atuação próxima aos clientes internos, com postura madura, clara e orientada à solução.
  • Gestão e desenvolvimento das coordenadoras regionais de R&S.
  • Negociação e relacionamento com fornecedores, incluindo prazos, processos e faturamento.
  • Apoio estratégico na transição do modelo descentralizado para a célula corporativa.

O que precisa para ser bem-sucedido

Buscamos uma profissional com sólida experiência em recrutamento de alto volume , forte capacidade de gestão de times e vivência em ambientes de grande escala.

Requisitos essenciais:

  • Experiência robusta em operações de R&S com grande volume de vagas.
  • Vivência em empresas ou consultorias com demanda massiva (alto volume efetivo e temporário).
  • Experiencia fazendo gestão de fornecedores (Consultorias)
  • Gestão de equipes grandes e distribuídas.
  • Inglês necessário.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de recrutamento (LinkedIn, InfoJobs, Catho).
  • Experiência com múltiplas áreas funcionais e operações de larga escala.

O que você obterá em troca

A oportunidade de liderar uma operação estratégica de R&S em plena transformação, com alta exposição às principais lideranças da companhia e impacto direto na construção do novo modelo de Talent Acquisition.

Você atuará em um ambiente colaborativo, dinâmico, com grande espaço para melhorias e desenvolvimento profissional, além de potencial real de evolução para uma futura posição gerencial.

O que precisa fazer agora

Se estiver interessada nesta posição, clique em “Aplicar-se agora” para enviar seu CV atualizado ou entre em contato conosco para mais informações.

title: Site Reliability Engineering Manager
description:
About the Team

SRE Middleware & Data (SRE M&D) enables product teams by providing secure, scalable, and automated data, middleware, and AI services on Azure.

Provisioning: Automates secure delivery of databases, queues, caches, and AI services/resources;
builds self-service andguardrails.

Reliability: Ensures availability, performance, and resilience of data, middleware, and AI services in production;
builds observability, autohealing, and disaster recovery.

What You Will Do

  • Lead and grow the team: Manage, mentor, and develop SRE engineers across Provisioning and Reliability.
  • Lead cross-team initiatives:
  • Align roadmaps with Architects and partner teams;
    ensure adoption of architecture standards.
  • Run design reviews and architecture signoffs;
    surface and mitigate risks and complexity early.
  • Translate standards into guardrails and automation (policyascode, selfservice) for consistent delivery.
  • Apply lightweight RACI and clear escalation paths to resolve tradeoffs quickly.

Drive roadmap and execution:

  • Provisioning: Self-service engines, Crossplane/Terraform-based automation, policy-as-code, secured pipelines, access management, backups/restore, Azure AI resource provisioning, and quota management.
  • Reliability: Observability integrations (New Relic, Azure Monitor), performance tuning, autohealing, DR/BCP, resilience testing, failover automation, SLOs, reliability for Azure AI services and messaging platforms (Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus).

Establish engineering excellence:

  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Crossplane) and CI/CD best practices.
  • Change management with safe deploys and rollback strategies.
  • Incident and problem management with blameless postmortems.
  • Continuous improvement loops measured by DORA/SRE metrics.
  • Champion security and compliance by design:
  • Policy as code, least privilege access, and secrets/identity hygiene.
  • Guardrails in self-service flows;
    auditability and evidence collection.
  • Partnership with Security/Compliance for standards and reviews.

Partner with the Architects:

  • Codevelop platform architecture and service standards.
  • Define SLIs/SLOs and capacity/reliability patterns for core services.
  • Align roadmaps and run design reviews for high-impact changes.

Own delivery outcomes:

  • Navigate competing priorities across a broad platform scope — balancing reactive operational load (incidents, toil, on-call) against proactive platform investment (self-service, automation, resilience) without a clean separation between the two.
  • Make and communicate prioritization decisions under ambiguity, with partial information, across teams that have conflicting urgency.
  • Maintain a defensible, visible backlog that reflects real risk and business impact — not just the loudest stakeholder.

Operate a healthy on-call:

  • High-quality playbooks and automation-first troubleshooting (AI-assisted).
  • Actionable alerts with SLO-based paging and noise reduction.
  • Regular resilience testing and post-incident hardening.

Initiatives You Will Lead:

  • Self-service provisioning for databases, queues, and caches with golden configurations and policy guardrails.
  • AI-assisted troubleshooting for provisioning and production incidents.
  • Platform wide observability integration for data, middleware, and AI services (New Relic, Azure Monitor).
  • Automated DR runbooks and resilience/chaos testing in production.
  • Performance tuning at service and query layers, including automated tuning workflows.
  • Standardization of provisioning via Terraform/Crossplane for databases, messaging, and AI services.
  • Governance for Azure AI services (quotas, access, safety guardrails) with clear consumption patterns for product teams.

Success Metrics

  • Reduced MTTR and incident count, improved SLO attainment for data/middleware services.
  • Improved lead time for change and change failure rate;
    increased automation coverage and reduced toil.
  • Faster time to provision and higher first success rate for self-service requests.
  • Measurable improvements in cost efficiency, performance, and capacity predictability.
  • Team health: engagement, growth, hiring velocity, stress levels, and retention.
  • SLO attainment for AI endpoints and messaging services;
    reduced alert noise viaimproved observability (New Relic/Azure Monitor).

What You Will Bring

  • Proven experience managing SRE/platform/infrastructure teams delivering production-critical services.
  • Deep familiarity with Azure and the team stack: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB;
    Redis;
    messaging systems such as CloudAMQP/RabbitMQ, Kafka, Event Hubs, and Service Bus.
  • Strong reliability fundamentals: SLOs/SLIs, incident and problem management, capacity, DR/BCP, performance tuning.
  • Solid automation background: IaC (Terraform/Crossplane), CI/CD (Azure DevOps), GitOps, policyascode, secrets and identity, RBAC.
  • Track record of building selfservice platforms and reducing toil.
  • Excellent crossfunctional leadership with product, security, and compliance partners.
  • Experience operating Azure AI services in production (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, AI Search).
  • Observability experience with New Relic, Azure Monitor, and OpenTelemetry.

What You’ll Need

  • Advanced skills in English
  • Experience with AI-assisted operations and troubleshooting.
  • Observability expertise (Prometheus/Grafana, New Relic, Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry).
  • Database performance engineering and query optimization.
  • Experience in regulated environments and security frameworks.
  • FinOps capabilities (cost governance, forecasting, rightsizing, quotas, budgets, chargeback/showback).

How We Work

  • Collaboration first with a strong partnership between the Engineering Manager and the Architects.
  • Automation by default;
    security and reliability are nonnegotiable.
  • Blameless postmortems, continuous learning, and measurable outcomes.
  • Participation in an equitable on-call rotation with high-quality runbooks and automation.

Tech Environment

Azure (AKS, managed databases, storage, networking, identity).

Azure AI services (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, AI Search).

Azure DevOps for CI/CD.

CloudAMQP (RabbitMQ).

Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB.

Caches: Redis.

Queues/Brokers: Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus.

Terraform/Crossplane, GitOps.

Observability: New Relic, Azure Monitor, logs, metrics, traces, alerting workflows.

Na Robert Half, acreditamos que diversidade de experiências, perspectivas e histórias fortalece nossos resultados. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, respeitoso e equitativo, onde cada pessoa pode ser quem é e atingir seu máximo potencial.
