title: Engenheiro De Dados Especialista
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Atividades:

  • Liderar a definição técnica e a evolução da estratégia de Data Lake, garantindo uma arquitetura robusta e escalável;
  • Desenhar e estruturar camadas de dados (Raw, Trusted, Refined) e fluxos de processamento baseados em padrões de ETL e ELT;
  • Estabelecer diretrizes para que a arquitetura suporte o crescimento de volume e complexidade da companhia;
  • Desenvolver e automatizar pipelines de dados complexos, garantindo a entrega eficiente para modelos preditivos e análises avançadas;
  • Otimizar continuamente o desempenho dos fluxos de dados, reduzindo latência e custos operacionais de processamento;
  • Implementar ferramentas e práticas que permitam a escalabilidade da modelagem de dados voltada à decisão estratégica;
  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vida da aquisição de dados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para os stakeholders;
  • Garantir a qualidade, integridade e confiabilidade dos dados, estabelecendo processos de monitoramento e validação;
  • Atuar como ponte entre a tecnologia e as áreas de negócio, garantindo que as soluções de dados estejam alinhadas aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa.

Requisitos:

  • Formação em Tecnologia.
  • Sólida experiência em pipelines e Big Data (Python/Java/Scala);
  • Vivência em liderança de equipes e metodologias ágeis;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Perfil autônomo, analítico, comunicativo e orientado a resultados.

Nossos benefícios:

title: Customer Success | Onboarding
description:
LEIA A DESCRIÇÃO!

Para se candidatar, preencha o formulário:

NOSSO JEITO DE SER E FAZER

O time da PayConductor é feito por pessoas obcecadas por resolver problemas reais de pagamentos: gente que entende que cada décimo de ponto na taxa de aprovação representa milhões na ponta dos nossos clientes. Acreditamos que orquestração não é só tecnologia, é devolver às empresas o controle sobre o seu próprio dinheiro. Construímos uma plataforma AI-driven que conecta adquirentes, gateways e meios de pagamento em uma única camada inteligente, e estamos só começando.

Se você quer fazer parte do time que está redefinindo a infraestrutura de pagamentos do Brasil, é aqui.

E aí, quer construir o futuro dos pagamentos com a gente?

O time de Customer Success da PayConductor é responsável por garantir que cada cliente extraia o máximo da nossa plataforma, desde a ativação até a evolução contínua da operação. Dentro do time, a área de Onboarding é o primeiro contato real do cliente com o produto: é onde a expectativa vendida vira valor entregue. A sua missão será conduzir a ativação de novos clientes, garantindo que cheguem à primeira transação com segurança, agilidade e a melhor configuração possível para o negócio deles.

Para este desafio, buscamos uma pessoa com vivência real em pagamentos, olhar estruturado para processos e capacidade de transitar com naturalidade entre conversas técnicas (APIs, integrações, fluxos de checkout) e conversas de negócio. Você vai atuar como ponto focal entre cliente, Produto, Engenharia e Comercial — e terá ownership para construir os playbooks, métricas e padrões que vão definir como a PayConductor implanta clientes em escala.

Você terá entre suas responsabilidades:

  • Conduzir o onboarding de novos clientes desde a assinatura do contrato até a primeira transação em produção.
  • Mapear o cenário do cliente (adquirentes, gateways, integrações, fluxos de checkout) e propor a melhor configuração na plataforma.
  • Estruturar e documentar processos, playbooks e fluxos de implementação, criando padrões escaláveis para o time.
  • Atuar como ponto focal entre cliente, Produto, Engenharia e Comercial durante toda a fase de implantação.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de onboarding (time-to-first-transaction, taxa de ativação, drop-offs) e propor melhorias contínuas.
  • Conduzir kick-offs, treinamentos e sessões de configuração com times técnicos e de negócio do cliente.
  • Identificar riscos de implantação, gargalos técnicos ou comerciais e atuar de forma proativa para destravar.
  • Levar feedback estruturado de clientes para Produto e Engenharia, contribuindo com a evolução da plataforma.

Você poderá agregar bastante ao nosso time se possuir:

  • 3+ anos de experiência em Customer Success, Onboarding, Implantação ou Solutions na indústria de pagamentos.
  • Conhecimento sólido do ecossistema de pagamentos: adquirentes, sub-adquirentes, gateways, antifraude, conciliação e meios de pagamento (cartão, Pix, boleto, carteiras digitais).
  • Experiência prévia conduzindo implementações que envolvem APIs e integrações técnicas.
  • Capacidade comprovada de estruturar processos, criar documentação e padronizar operações.
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal, transitando entre interlocutores técnicos e de negócio.
  • Organização, autonomia e visão analítica para tomada de decisão baseada em dados.

Você se destacará se tiver:

  • Experiência em plataformas de orquestração de pagamentos.
  • Vivência atendendo clientes enterprise, marketplaces ou e-commerces de alto volume.
  • Background técnico (leitura de documentação de API, entendimento de payloads, debug de integrações).
  • Experiência prévia em gateways, adquirentes ou outras fintechs.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CS (HubSpot, Intercom, Notion, Jira).

description:
We're hiring: Social Lead / Social Media & Community Manager

Earned Media Productions (EMP) is looking for someone who can turn podcasts into growth engines — and build engaged communities around them.

This role sits at the intersection of content distribution, social strategy, and audience engagement.

What you'll do:

- Own daily posting across TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, and more

- Turn podcast episodes into high-performing short-form content

- Decide what clips get posted, when, and where

- Manage comments, DMs, and community engagement across platforms

- Help shape the voice and presence of brands online

- Analyze performance and double down on what works

Key Responsibilities 1. Content Distribution & Posting
  • Own daily posting across all social platforms (TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, etc.)
  • Manage scheduling, captions, hashtags, and formatting per platform
  • Ensure consistent, high-volume output of podcast clips
2. Podcast Clip Strategy
  • Turn long-form podcast episodes into a structured content distribution plan
  • Decide what clips get posted, when, and where
  • Collaborate with editors to guide clip selection and packaging (hooks, titles, formats)
3. Growth & Optimization
  • Analyze performance data to identify winning formats, topics, and hooks
  • Continuously iterate on posting strategy to increase:
  • Views
  • Engagement
  • Follower growth
  • A/B test captions, formats, and posting times
4. Platform Expertise
  • Stay on top of trends, algorithm changes, and best practices across platforms
  • Adapt content strategy accordingly (e.G., TikTok vs. Reels vs. Shorts nuances)
5. Systems & Organization
  • Build and manage a content calendar + distribution system
  • Track posted content and performance metrics
  • Ensure no content bottlenecks between editing → posting → reporting
6. Collaboration
  • Work closely with:
  • Editors (to refine clips)
  • Creators/clients (to align on voice and goals)
  • Leadership (to align on growth strategy)
What we're looking for:

- Experience growing social accounts (especially short-form video)

- Strong understanding of TikTok / Reels / Shorts

- Someone who actually gets internet culture + audience behavior

- Ability to manage both content output + community interaction

Must-Haves
  • 2–4+ years managing social media accounts (preferably podcast or creator-led content)
  • Proven experience growing accounts through short-form video
  • Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
  • Strong instincts for what makes content go viral
  • Experience managing high-volume posting (multiple posts/day)
  • Fluent in English - Speaking and Writing.
Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience working with podcasts or long-form content
  • Background in content editing or scripting
  • Familiarity with tools like:
  • Asana/ Slack
  • Social schedulers (Later, Hootsuite, etc.)
  • Analytics tools
  • Experience managing multiple brands or clients
Bonus:

- Experience with podcasts or creator-led brands

- Background in content editing or scripting

- Experience building or managing online communities

This is a high-impact role with real ownership across content, distribution, and community.

title: Senior Ruby On Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.

Over the past 8 years, we've built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we're growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We're a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we're creating tools that our customers truly love.

About You
  • You're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications.
  • You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership. You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business.
  • You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews.
  • You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically.
  • You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects.
  • You're curious about IoT, WiFi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.
  • You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight.
About the Role
  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, React and JavaScript, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS.
  • Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO.
  • Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively.
  • Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers.
  • Lead by example in pull request culture;
    writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team.
  • Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team.
Why Work at StayFi?
  • You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy.
  • Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product.
  • You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industry in a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations.
  • As you continue to help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.
  • You'll gain visibility into the full lifecycle of a sustainable, founder-led business well beyond just writing code.

title: Data Scientist - Sênior (Motor De Busca)
description: No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Busca, com foco em Busca Semântica, relevância e ranking. Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual). Experiência com modelos de ranking ou learning to rank. Domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados. Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem. Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto. Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos. Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps. Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.Diferenciais Vivência com BigQuery ou data lakes. Experiência prévia em e-commerce, marketplace ou plataformas de discovery. Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca. Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling. Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.Perfil esperado Forte mentalidade de produto e experiência do usuário. Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto. description:

Strong knowledge ofCentral Bank of Brazilrisk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements. postgraduate qualification preferred. Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills;
fluency inPortuguese and English. Must meetfit and properstandards withno disqualifying factors, including: not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised. not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

tratamento.Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores contínuo.Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos Medicina (CRM);

ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência médica. Pós ou Especialização na área;

description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.What It's Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn't a place for coasting—it's a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you'll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You'll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose:We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intentionIf your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you've been waiting for.About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role isapplying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have... 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgmentand comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness packageCandidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados.

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
  • Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
  • Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
  • Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
  • Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
  • Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
  • Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
  • Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
  • Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
  • Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
  • Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
  • Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
  • Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
  • Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
  • Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
  • Conhecimento emGit e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
  • Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
  • Disponibilidadepara atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado.

Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento).
  • Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança).
  • Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados).
  • Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions).
  • Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas).
  • Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos).
  • Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards).
  • Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio).

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente!

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang)
description:
OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICATitle:Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations Company:Fulcrum SaaS Location: Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:Full-time Level:Senior / Staff Compensation:USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and locationAbout Fulcrum SaaS Fulcrum SaaS is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant SaaS environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable. Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.The Role We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers. You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars. You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.What You'll Do Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements. Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery. Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/BigQuery or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation. Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise. Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure. Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation. Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.What We're Looking For (Must-Haves) 5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better). Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes. Deep working knowledge of Go's concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity. Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/BigQuery strongly preferred;
Cassandra, DynamoDB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable. Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures. Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like. Multi-tenant SaaS experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure. Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable. Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate. Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).Strong Nice-to-Haves Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic). A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks. Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches. Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.What We Offer Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM. Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices. Direct access to leadership;
your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented. A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.How to Apply Please apply through LinkedIn with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting: Your experience with Go in production. The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned. Your country of residence and preferred start date. You can also include links to GitHub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

description: Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Resume:

English version only.

Highlight experiences in .NET MVC and .NET Maui

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer contractor to join our U.S.-based team remotely. You will leverage your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects.

In this role, you will work on our healthcare platform, gaining deep system knowledge and contributing to our Agile workflow via Azure DevOps. You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews, expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. Your role will evolve based on your strengths and our needs — all while adhering to rigorous coding and security standards .

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Design & Development

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to design software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancing existing codebases (opportunities starting around months 3–4).

2. Testing & Quality

  • Design and implement automated End-to-End (E2E) tests (e.G., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability — with a strong focus during your first 6–9 months.

3. Peer Reviews & Post-Release Support

  • Participate in pre-release feature reviews (ongoing).
  • Conduct initial post-release bug ticket analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.

4. Agile Collaboration

  • Actively contribute to 2-week sprints and 6-week release cycles (3 sprints per release).
  • Participate in sprint planning, pull requests, releases, and daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT).

5. Communication & Coordination

  • Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical team members across time zones.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 8 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record on complex projects.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Application (.NET 8) for mobile and web development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure (Azure App Service, Azure SQL, Azure Storage).
  • Proficient with modern development tools (Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with healthcare software or Protected Health Information standards (e.G., HIPAA).
  • Experience with pull request reviews and sprint participation.

How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: 2-week sprints, 6-week release cycles, daily stand-ups at 3:00 PM CT.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.G., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tools: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and more.
  • Team Culture: Accountability, quality, and excellence in delivery.

title: Product Owner - Sênior
description:
Product Owner - Sênior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

No seu dia a dia, você gerenciará o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias. Atuará como principal interlocutor entre as áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório, supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis. Você liderará cerimônias ágeis e garantirá a entrega contínua de valor, promovendo melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás. Além disso, acompanhará métricas de desempenho do produto (KPIs de negócio e de uso), proporá evoluções baseadas em dados e feedback dos usuários, e garantirá que as soluções desenvolvidas estejam em conformidade com as normas de segurança e regulação do setor de gás.

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Gerenciar o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias.
  • Atuar como principal interlocutor(a) entre áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório e supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis.
  • Liderar cerimônias ágeis e garantir a entrega contínua de valor para o produto.
  • Promover melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás.
  • Acompanhar métricas de desempenho (KPIs de negócio e de uso), analisando dados para direcionar evoluções do produto.
  • Propor melhorias com base em dados e feedbacks dos usuários.
  • Garantir que as soluções estejam em conformidade com normas de segurança e regulação do setor.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Visão holística e estratégica, com capacidade de compreender o negócio de distribuição de gás de ponta a ponta, conectando iniciativas de tecnologia às metas do negócio.
  • Perfil de liderança com forte viés de execução, sendo "mão na massa", orientado(a) a resultados e capaz de remover impedimentos para garantir entregas com qualidade e agilidade.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de transitar entre áreas, atuando como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia.
  • Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e práticas de gestão de produto (roadmaps, OKRs, MVPs).
  • Experiência na liderança de squads multidisciplinares e atuação em ciclos de discovery e delivery.
  • Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.

Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Negócios, Energia ou Transformação Digital.
  • Tiver certificações em Product Ownership (CSPO, PSPO) e metodologias ágeis (CSM, SAFe).
  • Tiver familiaridade com o setor de gás e energia, incluindo regulação da ANP e processos como medição, faturamento, logística e segurança operacional.
  • Demonstrar forte visão sistêmica e pensamento crítico.
  • Apresentar habilidade de negociação e influência.
  • Ser resiliente e adaptável em ambientes de alta complexidade.
  • Ter perfil colaborativo e facilitador.
  • Demonstrar orientação a resultados e senso de urgência.
  • Possuir experiência em contextos dinâmicos.

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente!

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience.

About Us

Publicity For Good (PFG) is a US-based, female-founded public relations agency that partners with impact-driven, heart-centered leaders and purpose-driven CPG brands (Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty). We are an all-female team dedicated to amplifying brands that make a difference through meaningful visibility and measurable growth. We operate in a fun, fast-paced environment where collaboration creates magic.

Role

This position is responsible for generating and nurturing qualified leads with the primary objective of booking sales calls. The Lead Generation Specialist will manage inbound and outbound lead channels, validate prospect interest, coordinate with the sales team, and maintain an organized pipeline across multiple platforms.

As a Lead Generation Specialist, you will monitor and respond to leads from various sources including Meta ads, Leadhype, Smartlead, and GoHighLevel (GHL). You will conduct call show audits, manage follow-up sequences, update pipeline statuses, and ensure seamless handoff of qualified prospects to the sales team. This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional organization, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems while maintaining high response rates and booking quality.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor and respond to new leads across all platforms (GHL, Leadhype, Smartlead, Meta ads).
  • Conduct daily call show audits and update show/no-show statuses in tracking systems.
  • Manage and update the Airtable Lead Gen dashboard with accurate lead data and metrics.
  • Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects.
  • Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns.
  • Review and respond to positive replies from Leadhype and Smartlead outreach campaigns.
  • Update lead tags, statuses, and ownership in GHL based on prospect engagement and stage.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized.
  • Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence.
  • Process and segment new Meta ads leads into appropriate workflows.
  • Review notes from sales reps in GHL and take necessary follow-up actions.
  • Update sales team on lead status changes, show/no-show patterns, and booking confirmations.
  • Track daily lead generation metrics including new conversations, responses, and bookings.
  • Identify and flag low-quality leads or technical issues with lead sources.
  • Maintain organized conversation threads and ensure timely responses to all inquiries.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
  • Test and optimize messaging templates across platforms to improve response rates.
  • Ensure all lead generation software and integrations function properly.

Results

  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales call booking targets.
  • Maintain high response rates across all lead channels (within 1-2 hours for new leads).
  • Deliver accurate and timely daily reports on lead generation activities and pipeline status.
  • Ensure qualified leads are properly nurtured and handed off to sales with complete context.
  • Identify trends in lead quality, response rates, and show/no-show patterns.
  • Maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline with proper tagging and segmentation.
  • Support predictable sales pipeline through consistent lead flow and booking quality.
  • Reduce lead leakage by ensuring no prospect falls through the cracks.
  • Contribute to improved conversion rates through effective qualification and pre-call preparation.

Requirements

  • Prior experience in lead generation, sales development, or appointment setting of at least 2 years.
  • Strong written communication skills with ability to engage prospects effectively.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, especially GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with lead generation platforms such as Leadhype, Smartlead, or comparable systems.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple lead sources and prioritize high-value opportunities.
  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and time management skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Comfortable working with data, tracking metrics, and identifying performance patterns.
  • Experience with Airtable, Google Workspace, and project management tools preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms and systems.
  • Results-driven mindset with focus on meeting and exceeding KPIs.
  • Ability to handle high-volume communication while maintaining quality and personalization.
  • Professional, persistent, and positive attitude with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Discretion in handling sensitive prospect and client information.
  • Adaptability to changing priorities and willingness to optimize processes continuously.

The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience.

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L

Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers, and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.

Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.

Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).

Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.

Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round .
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‐onboarding requirements .

After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

description: Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. Source and maintaindeep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desksacross relevant regions. Improveexecution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .Market Development Identify and onboardnew liquidity providers and OTC trading partnersacross emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks forilliquid currency pairsand support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development ofscalable FX infrastructuresupporting global payments and settlement flows.Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experiencein Emerging Markets. Strong experience tradingAfrican or LATAM currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executingOTC and institutional-sized FX trades .Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity withFIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate inhigh-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network withinEM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.Preferred Qualifications Experience supportinghigh-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience tradingEM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity withstablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background inbuilding or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environmentsVision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. title: Senior Backend Engineer (Node.Js) | Integração
description:
Descrição da Empresa: A Carefy é uma plataforma especializada em auditoria para operadoras de planos de saúde, utilizando inteligência artificial para combater fraudes e desperdícios no ciclo de atendimento. Combinamos tecnologia avançada e expertise em fluxos de auditoria para gerar economias significativas para nossos clientes. Nosso impacto abrange mais de 8 milhões de pessoas, trabalhando com operadoras líderes como Hapvida e Porto Seguro. Somos movidos pelo compromisso de transformar decisões complexas e melhorar a sustentabilidade do setor de saúde.

Descrição do Cargo: Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend Sênior com forte visão arquitetural e experiência em sistemas de alta escalabilidade para atuar no time de integração da Carefy. Esse cargo envolve o desenho e desenvolvimento de soluções para garantir a interoperabilidade da plataforma com os sistemas das operadoras de saúde, assegurando fluxo de dados com segurança e alta performance.

Você deverá propor soluções, analisar requisitos técnicos e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entregar projetos de alto impacto. Atuará como referência técnica, participando diretamente da definição de arquiteturas junto aos times de TI dos clientes e traduzindo desafios complexos em soluções estruturadas para o time interno. Também será responsável por elevar o nível técnico da equipe por meio da definição de padrões de engenharia, disseminação de boas práticas e organização das demandas.

Qualificações

  • Acima de 6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software
  • Acima de 4 anos com Node.Js e TypeScript em produção
  • Acima de 4 anos com bancos relacionais (MySQL), incluindo modelagem e otimização
  • Experiência com arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Hexagonal, DDD)
  • Experiência com cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) e mensageria (RabbitMQ/Kafka)
  • Experiência com APIs RESTful escaláveis
  • Experiência em ambientes de alta criticidade e alto volume de dados
  • Domínio de frameworks como NestJS e/ou Next.Js
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados (TDD, unitários e integração)
  • Habilidade para trabalho colaborativo
  • Visão sistêmica e entendimento do impacto técnico no produto
  • Comunicação assertiva com clientes e time interno
  • Autonomia para conduzir projetos complexos e gerenciar riscos
  • Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas com foco na causa raiz

Será um diferencial:

  • Experiência com PHP: Temos legado e integrações onde esse conhecimento será muito útil para modernização;
  • Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;
  • Vivência com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);
  • Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2).

Atribuições:

  • Interface Técnica com Clientes: Atuar como ponto focal em reuniões com os times de TI dos clientes (operadoras de saúde) para alinhar requisitos de integração, layouts de dados e especificações de API;
  • Gestão e Organização Técnica: Traduzir requisitos de negócio em tarefas técnicas claras, quebrando demandas complexas em entregáveis menores para orientar o trabalho dos desenvolvedores Juniors e Plenos;
  • Arquitetura e Design: Projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alta performance utilizando Node.Js (NestJS/Next.Js);
  • Sustentação e Confiabilidade: Atuar na manutenção dos sistemas em produção, identificando, diagnosticando e corrigindo bugs e falhas (em sistemas, fontes de dados e APIs) de forma ágil para garantir a continuidade dos serviços;
  • Mentoria e Qualidade: Realizar Code Reviews rigorosos e disseminar boas práticas (Clean Code, SOLID), elevando a barra técnica da equipe;
  • Padronização e Performance: Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e identificar gargalos de performance em cenários de alto volume de dados.

O que oferecemos?

  • Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido ou 100% Remoto
  • Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ;
  • Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VR);
  • Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador;
  • Horários flexíveis;
  • Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!

title: English Teacher
description: Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. title: Logistics Operations Manager
description:
We're Hiring: Operations & Logistics Manager (E-commerce)

Location: (Remote/Brazil | Full-time

We're looking for an Operations & Logistics Manager who can keep products moving smoothly—from supplier to customer—without drama. If you love building systems, solving shipping puzzles, and making fulfillment faster + cheaper, you'll fit right in.

What you'll own

You'll be the glue between supply chain, fulfillment, and customer experience. Key responsibilities include but not limited to:

  • Manage end-to-end logistics: inbound freight, warehousing/3PL, outbound shipping
  • Own relationships + performance with 3PLs, carriers, freight forwarders, and vendors
  • Improve shipping speed, accuracy, and cost (aka: fewer "where is my package?" moments)
  • Oversee inventory flow and replenishment planning to prevent stockouts/overstock
  • Create and maintain SOPs for receiving, picking/packing, returns, and exception handling
  • Build dashboards for key KPIs (OTIF, shipping cost/order, fulfillment accuracy, returns rate)
  • Lead continuous improvement projects (process, tools, automation, packaging optimization)
  • Coordinate cross-functionally with CX, marketing, finance, and product team on launches and promos
What success looks like (90 days)

3PL/carrier performance clearly tracked and improved

Fewer shipping issues + faster resolution time

Clear SOPs + smoother handoffs between teams

Inventory is more predictable (less "oops we ran out")

Shipping costs are controlled while service levels stay strong

What we're looking for
  • 3+ years in logistics/operations (bonus: DTC e-commerce, Shopify, Amazon, or retail)
  • Strong vendor management skills (you can hold partners accountable politely but firmly)
  • Solid understanding of shipping + freight (domestic and/or international)
  • Comfortable with data + spreadsheets (you can measure stuff, not just "feel" stuff)
  • Organized, proactive, and calm when things go sideways (because... they will)
  • Process builder: you document, improve, and automate—not just "do the work"
Tools you may use (nice to have)

Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, NetSuite/QuickBooks, ShipStation/ShipBob, 3PL portals, Asana/ClickUp, Airtable, Google Sheets/Excel, Zapier/Make

Why join us

We're growing fast and need someone who can help us scale without breaking fulfillment. You'll have real ownership, a direct impact on profitability + customer experience, and a team that moves quickly.

How to apply

Send your resume + a short note answering:

  • What's one logistics or fulfillment process you improved, and what changed?
  • What systems/3PLs/carriers have you worked with?

title: Commercial Lead — Brazil
description: About Regrow Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.About the Role As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow's commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil's agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.You will work closely with our Head of LatAm, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow's platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.What You'll Do Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close. Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts. Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting. Expand Regrow's presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions. Position Regrow credibly within Brazil's grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context. Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions. Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals. Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.What You'll Bring Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2B environments. Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term. Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains. Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions. Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or SaaS platforms. Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller. Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals. Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts. Native or near-native Portuguese fluency. Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly. Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.Nice to Have Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies. Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries. Working knowledge of Spanish.Why Regrow Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale. High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership. A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise. Competitive compensation and benefits.Acerca de Regrow Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.Sobre el Rol Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de LatAm, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.Qué Harás Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre. Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas. Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast. Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras. Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local. Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas. Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias. Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.Qué Aportarás Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2B complejos. Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo. Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial. Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras. Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas SaaS. Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional. Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas. Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento. Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués. Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular. Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.Deseable Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento. Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales. Conocimiento funcional del español.Por Qué Regrow Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala. Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real. Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica. Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

title: Dados Cientista De Dados Especialista - Inteligência Artificial Llm | (Remoto)
description:
A missão do Cientista de Dados será atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas para um produto de Analytics voltado a softwares de RH, contribuindo com a análise e modelagem de dados voltados à gestão de pessoas e processos. Fará parte de um time multidisciplinar responsável por criar modelos preditivos, gerar insights estratégicos e estruturar pipelines de dados eficientes.

Também participará da implementação e treinamento de LLMs (Large Language Models) aplicados ao contexto de RH, apoiando a evolução do produto com foco em personalização e escalabilidade.

O profissional terá um papel essencial na transformação de dados complexos em soluções inteligentes e aplicáveis ao negócio.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Trabalhar em equipe no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas aplicadas ao contexto de Recursos Humanos.
  • Realizar exploração, tratamento e modelagem de dados para gerar insights estratégicos.
  • Desenvolver modelos estatísticos e preditivos voltados à análise de comportamento, desempenho e gestão de pessoas.
  • Atuar na implementação, ajuste fino e avaliação de desempenho de LLMs aplicados ao produto.
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções baseadas em dados.
  • Contribuir com a documentação técnica e boas práticas de ciência de dados.

title: Senior Web Manager
description: About the Role: We are looking for a visionary Senior Web Manager to lead the transformation of our marketing website into a high-performing, modern digital engine. Vendor & Technical Management: Manage relationships with external agencies and developers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.What We're Looking For: Experience: 5–8+ years in web management or digital strategy, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment. Frontend Skills: Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build and troubleshoot custom web components. SEO & Analytics: Advanced knowledge of technical SEO principles and web analytics tools like GA4 and Google Tag Manager. Project Management: Proven ability to manage complex website redesigns or migrations from strategy through execution. Mindset: A data-driven, self-starter who can translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and is passionate about building a best-in-class digital experience.Why Join Us: This is a high-impact role where you will have the autonomy to shape our digital future. You'll be part of a team that values innovation, out-of-the-box thinking, and creating exceptional customer experiences.

title: Software Engineer
description: Exciting New Career Opportunity:Software Engineer - Quality & AI Infrastructure Company:Hirebus Location:Remote in Brazil Pay:$30K-$60K per yearWe're hiring a mid-level engineer to own two things: the quality of our codebase and the early foundations of our AI agent work.The role Most of your time will be spent making our existing software more reliable. You'll dig into production bugs, trace them to root cause, and write the tests that should have caught them. You'll review pull requests in a way that raises the bar without demoralizing anyone. You'll tackle the tech debt that everyone complains about in retros but nobody picks up.The other part — and this is growing — is our AI agent work. We're building tooling, orchestration, and evaluation systems for LLM-powered features. This isn't a research project. It's production software that needs the same rigor as everything else we ship. We need someone who can bring that rigor.What you'll do Debug and fix issues across the stack, from staging through production Build meaningful test coverage (the kind that actually catches regressions) Review code thoroughly — with context, not just style nits Refactor the parts of the codebase that slow the team down Help define how we ship: observability, release process, quality gates Work with product and design to land features cleanly Contribute to our AI agent infrastructure: tool-calling, orchestration, evaluation, safetyTechnical Requirements 7+ years of professional engineering experience with a track record of shipping production SaaS products Expert in Node.Js, React, and TypeScript with strong product architecture instincts (scalability, maintainability, speed of iteration) Hands-on Supabase experience: Postgres schema design, RLS policies, edge functions, and auth Shipped production LLM-powered features (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) with a working understanding of prompt engineering, evals, latency/cost tradeoffs, and guardrails Experience building agentic workflows, RAG systems, or tool-use integrations (MCP, function calling) Excellent written English and self-directed async work style, with meaningful overlap with US Mountain Time Comfortable using AI-native development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily workflowYour first 90 days: Month 1: You've shipped real bug fixes. You're in the PR review rotation and contributing useful feedback. You have context on the parts of the system that break most often. Month 2: Test coverage in your area has improved measurably. You've identified at least one chunk of tech debt worth prioritizing and started on it. Month 3: You've shipped a meaningful refactor. You've made your first contributions to the AI agent infrastructure — something concrete, with results we can point to.We're not looking for someone who wants to rewrite everything from scratch. We want someone who makes the team steadily better — through reliable fixes, honest reviews, and the kind of infrastructure work that compounds over time. If you're also curious about what engineering looks like as AI agents become part of the workflow, even better.

title: Senior Developer In Spyglass
description:
Senior Developer with primary focus on Spyglass Event Configuration Management

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement Event Correlation Rules within Spyglass to aggregate disparate logs and metrics into meaningful business events;
  • Configure EventPolicies Suppression Rules and Deduplication logic to reduce alert fatigue for L1/L2 support teams
  • Build and maintain Spyglass Dashboards that provide real time visibility into the health of the FMCG application landscape
  • Experience Engineering Mobile and Emerging Tech
  • Integrate Spyglass with diverse data sources Azure Monitor GCP Cloud Logging AWS CloudWatch and ELKFalcon LogScale
  • Manage the lifecycle of an event from ingestion and normalization to correlation alerting and archival
  • Proactive Monitoring SRE Integration
  • Develop Thresholdbased and Anomaly detection alerts to identify performance degradation before it impacts the consumer experience
  • Implement Service Level Objective SLO monitoring within Spyglass to track the reliability of critical business paths, eg OrdertoCash, Checkout flows
  • Automate the creation of incidents in ITSM tools, eg ServiceNow, based on Spyglass event triggers
  • Build Situation Rooms or high level executive views within Spyglass for major promotional events or seasonal peaks
  • Ensure seamless event ingestion from hyperscaler hosted microservices AKSGKE and serverless functions
  • Support the monitoring of Integration Platforms Boomi APIM by capturing and correlating middleware execution events
  • Collaborate with the Cloud Infrastructure team to monitor network latency and connectivity events across the global AzureGCP backbone

Senior Developer Specifics

  • Lead the architectural design of the Global Event Management Strategy
  • Define enterprise standards for event metadata severity levels and correlation patterns
  • Mentor junior developers in eventdriven observability and AIOps principles
  • Conduct PostMortem analysis of major incidents to refine Spyglass correlation rules and prevent recurrence

Must have

  • Spyglass Event Management Expert level, proficiency in Spyglass configuration rule writing and dashboarding
  • Event Correlation Deep understanding of event patterns deduplication and suppression logic
  • Observability Integration Hands on experience connecting Spyglass to Azure Monitor, GCP Stackdriver or ELK
  • ITSM Integration
  • Proven experience integrating event platforms with ServiceNow or similar tools
  • Data Normalization, Ability to parse and normalize logs events from heterogeneous sources JSON, XML, Syslog
